evidence: Combined sweep and staging update restoration source review. Retained sweep native-route removals and owner-facing response shapes remain as reviewed before. The update protocol now restores staging b30f2b25e: claim route, pending/dispatched/applying/applied/cancelled fields, attempt deadlines, lifecycle status and recovery endpoints. These match the native build 1 staging contract. Central rank intake remains in the sweep; native owner requests do not carry employee headers. The only update runner exception is validate_schema_ancestry acceptance of goal_holders and canonical_manager_identities after candidate graph resolution. It changes no HTTP or Swift contract. Minimum native build stays 1. This is source compatibility review only. No signed-device, TestFlight, native draft survival or reconnect checks ran. Scratch install and focused runtime results are separate evidence. New staging merge source review: Source review of the explicit-reply removal merged with staging b30f2b25e keeps native build 1 compatible; the minimum remains 1. No HTTP route, request body or response shape changed: send-message, ticket proposal rejection and every conversation route take and return the same fields. The conversation view no longer emits rows or status of kind explicit_reply_missing. The Swift ConversationBody, row and Happened models decode kind as a plain String and have no case for that kind, so its absence changes nothing on device. VIEW_PROJECTION_VERSION stays 4, so cached view cursors stay valid. The removed reply-requirement block was server-to-agent wire text that the app never reads. Staging's own backend changes in this range are the legacy owner-update repair in update_requests.py and update_runner.py, which staging already reviewed as compatible, and server_lifecycle shutdown, process identity and supervisor changes, which serve no HTTP route the app calls. Not checked on a signed device or TestFlight. The sweep retains its removed features and exact restored owner-update protocol. The approved runner exception now also admits retire_explicit_reply_requirement after candidate graph resolution. Fresh schema and both staging starts omit reply-credit storage. These migration admission changes add no native-facing route or required native field. No signed-device checks ran for the combined merge. Background work agreement source review (Ticket t_z0pywvze): native build 1 stays compatible and the minimum remains 1. The only HTTP shape change is one added field, background_tasks (a list of task_id and task_description), on the conversation view status in snapshots and tail changes. The Swift ConversationStatus decodes authority, turnRunning, liveOutput and rest with Decodable and convertFromSnakeCase, names no CodingKeys, and so ignores the new key. No route, request body or existing field changed. VIEW_PROJECTION_VERSION and the executor protocol (20) are unchanged. The other backend changes are the Claude adapter following Claude's live task set, and the core holding stopped tasks until the agent acts. Neither serves a route the app calls. Not checked on a signed device or TestFlight.
